title: TRACER Seg for Cirro
description: Refine Xenium transcript-to-cell assignments with an explicit PMI/cPMI reference.

transcripts.title: Xenium transcripts
transcripts.description: Xenium transcripts Parquet. Existing cell_id and overlaps_nucleus assignments are used unless vector boundaries are supplied.

pmi.title: PMI / cPMI reference
pmi.description: Required long-format CSV(.gz) containing gene_i, gene_j, and PMI or NPMI. The selected path and SHA-256 are recorded.

cell_boundaries.title: Cell boundaries (optional)
cell_boundaries.description: Optional Xenium vector cell boundaries (Parquet/CSV/GeoJSON). When set, polygon membership replaces transcript cell_id.

nucleus_boundaries.title: Nucleus boundaries (optional)
nucleus_boundaries.description: Optional Xenium vector nucleus boundaries. When set, polygon membership defines overlaps_nucleus.

user_config.title: TRACER TOML override (optional)
user_config.description: Optional TRACER TOML layered after the selected platform preset. The fully resolved config is saved.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Short output label; letters, numbers, dot, underscore, and dash only.

platform.title: Platform preset
platform.description: TRACER preset: xenium for standard panels or atera for Xenium 5K.

qv_min.title: Minimum QV (optional)
qv_min.description: Keep rows with qv strictly greater than this value. Leave blank to keep all QV values.

remove_control_probes.title: Remove control probes
remove_control_probes.description: Remove Xenium control and non-gene probes before TRACER.

drop_unassigned.title: Drop unassigned transcripts
drop_unassigned.description: Normally false: TRACER uses unassigned transcripts to reconstruct partial cells.

pmi_threshold.title: PMI threshold (optional)
pmi_threshold.description: Explicit TRACER PMI threshold override. Leave blank for the resolved preset/config value.

g_z_um.title: Z-bin size (optional)
g_z_um.description: Positive microns or auto. Leave blank for the platform/config value.

tau.title: QC coherence threshold (optional)
tau.description: Purity/conflict threshold. Leave blank for metric-aware TRACER defaults.

min_tx_per_cell_for_scores.title: Minimum transcripts for QC
min_tx_per_cell_for_scores.description: Minimum transcripts per cell for purity/conflict scoring.

score_mode.title: QC score mode
score_mode.description: Count is bounded and recommended; magnitude weights PMI strength.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Deterministic TRACER and Python random seed.

cpus.title: CPUs
cpus.description: CPU request and numerical-library thread limit.

memory_gb.title: Initial memory (GB)
memory_gb.description: Initial memory request; retry attempts scale this value.

max_memory_gb.title: Maximum retry memory (GB)
max_memory_gb.description: Cap for retry scaling; must be at least initial memory.

max_retries.title: OOM retries
max_retries.description: Retries for transient/OOM exits; memory increases once per attempt.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Local output directory. Cirro overrides this with the destination dataset path.
